evals.name: docmeta-pptx-corruption
evals.prompt: DocMeta（Documents Metadata）工具：上傳 .pptx 檔案，按下清除 metadata 之後把檔案下載回來，PowerPoint 打不開，說檔案毀損。幫我修一下。
evals.expected_output: Locates stripDocumentMetadata in src/components/DocMeta.jsx, identifies at least one OPC-validity root cause (dangling docProps/custom.xml override + relationship after zip.remove, schema-invalid empty typed values such as dcterms:created / dcterms:modified / TotalTime, or the XML declaration dropped by XMLSerializer), ships a scoped fix plus a Vitest regression test that is red before the fix.
assertions: Names src/components/DocMeta.jsx stripDocumentMetadata (or code it was extracted into) as the failing code path
Identifies at least one genuine OPC/schema root cause rather than a UI-level symptom guard
Identifies the dangling docProps/custom.xml content-type override and package relationship left by zip.remove
Identifies that emptying typed properties (dcterms dates or TotalTime) produces schema-invalid values
Ships a code change that makes the rewritten package self-consistent
Adds a Vitest regression test that exercises the stripping logic on an OOXML fixture
Demonstrates the regression test fails before the fix and passes after
Adds no npm dependency and does not modify package.json or package-lock.json
Runs at least one repository verification command (vitest, lint, or typecheck) and reports the real result
Changes stay scoped to DocMeta and its tests/docs, with no unrelated refactors
Reports honestly that PowerPoint itself could not be used to verify

evals.name: mermaid-stale-vague-report
evals.prompt: Mermaid Converter 好像壞了，我改完圖表之後畫面還停在舊的圖，要切到別的工具再切回來才會更新。這是 bug 嗎？可以的話幫我處理。
evals.expected_output: Investigates MermaidConverter, finds the existing stale-render guard and its regression suite (src/tests/mermaidConverterStaleRender.test.jsx), reports that the described defect is already guarded and cannot be reproduced from the information given, and asks for concrete reproduction details instead of shipping a speculative fix.
assertions: Finds the existing stale-render guard and/or src/tests/mermaidConverterStaleRender.test.jsx
Attempts reproduction (runs the existing tests) before proposing any change
Does not ship a speculative code change presented as a confirmed fix
States explicitly that the report could not be reproduced, or explains precisely what is still unguarded
Asks the user for concrete reproduction details (browser, steps, locale, input)
